newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kia says sold 72,353 vehicles in April.
newsitem.headline: Kia says sold 72,353 vehicles in April.

text.p: Kia Motors, South Korea's second largest carmaker, on Friday reported sales of 72,353 vehicles in April, up from 68,373 a year earlier.
Exports were 40,070 against 28,012 a year earlier and domestic sales 32,283 against 40,361, a statement said.
"Exports to the United States, Europe and Indonesia increased steadily in April," said a Kia spokesman. But he did not give further details.
He said domestic sales were hampered by a slowing economy that forced consumers to cut spending on durable goods like cars.
Recent introduction of new models by the nation's third-ranked Daewoo Motor Co Ltd also affected Kia's domestic sales in the month, he said.
Daewoo began selling its Leganza mid-sized sedans in April.
